caption: Ya Sin.
We swear by the wise Qur'an.
Lo! thou art of those sent.
On a straight path.
A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful.
That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless.
Already hath the judgment proved true of most of them, for they believe not.
We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are stiff-necked.
We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and have covered them so that they see not.
Whether thou warn them or warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not.
Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret - to him, forgiveness and a rich reward.
We bring the dead to life, and We keep all things recorded in a clear Register.
Coin for them a similitude: the people of the city when the messengers came unto them.
We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third.
They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us; ye do but lie!
They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you.
And our duty is but plain conveyance of the message.
They said: We augur ill of you - if ye desist not, we shall surely stone you.
Your evil augury be with you! Nay, but ye are froward folk!
There came from the uttermost part of the city a man running: O my people, follow those who have been sent!
Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided.
For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back?
Shall I take other gods in His place, when their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save?
Then truly I should be in error manifest.
Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me!
It was said unto him: Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew.
With what munificence my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones!
We sent not down against his people a host from heaven, nor do We ever send.
It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct.
Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came a messenger but they mocked him!
Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which returned not?
But all, without exception, will be brought before Us.
A token is the dead earth: We revive it and bring forth grain so that they eat thereof.
We placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and springs gushing forth.
That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not give thanks?
Glory be to Him Who created all the pairs, of the earth's growth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not!
A token is night: We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness.
And the sun runneth unto a resting-place for it: that is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.
For the moon We appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.
The sun cannot overtake the moon, nor does night outstrip the day; each floateth in an orbit.
A token is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship.
And We created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.
deck_title: Of the Like Whereon They Ride

caption: If We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved.
Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while.
When it is said: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy.
Never came a token of their Lord to them, but they turned away from it!
When it is said: Spend of that Allah hath provided you, they say: Shall we feed them?
And they say: When will this promise be, if ye are truthful?
They await but one Shout, which will take them while they are disputing.
Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk.
And the trumpet is blown, and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord.
They cry: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our sleep? The Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.
It is but one Shout, and behold them assembled before Us!
This day no soul is wronged in aught; ye are requited only what ye used to do.
Those who merit paradise this day are happily employed.
They and their wives, in pleasant shade, upon thrones reclining.
Theirs is the fruit of their deeds, and theirs all that they ask.
The word from a Merciful Lord is: Peace!
But depart, O guilty ones, this day!
Did I not charge you, O sons of Adam, not to worship the devil - your open foe?
But to worship Me: that was the right path.
Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense?
This is hell which ye were promised.
Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved.
This day We seal their mouths; their hands speak and their feet bear witness.
Had We willed, We could have quenched their eyesight. How then could they have seen?
Had We willed, We could have fixed them in their place, powerless to go forward or back.
Whom We bring to old age, We reverse in creation. Have ye then no sense?
We have not taught him poetry, nor is it meet for him: this is but a Reminder and a plain Lecture.
To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers.
Have they not seen how We created for them cattle of Our handiwork, so that they are their owners?
And We have subdued them: some for riding, some for food.
deck_title: Some for Riding, Some for Food

caption: Benefits and divers drinks have they from them. Will they not give thanks?
And they have taken gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped.
It is not in their power to help them; they are but a host unto them.
Let not their speech grieve thee: We know what they conceal and what they proclaim.
deck_title: Let Not Their Speech Grieve Thee

caption: Hath not man seen that We created him from a seed-drop, yet he is an open opponent?
And he hath forgotten his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they are rotten?
Say: He reviveth them Who produced them at the first, Knower of every creation.
Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it.
Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create their like? He is the All-Wise Creator.
His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.
Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion of all things! Unto Him ye are brought back.
